verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform with a Dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack describes an in-product AI assistant or agent that users can delegate tasks to. The docs cover accounts, payments, cards, lending, a sandbox, an OpenAPI spec and webhooks, none of which is an AI assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
